statement: Let L be the free pro-2 group on ah,j, with h ∈ (Z/4)2 and 0 ≤ j ≤ 2, and let σ(ah,j) = a−1 bj−h,j, where bj mod 2 ̸= 0. Equip L with the basis and weights of Lemma 4.1. There are 24 elements g ∈ L, with assigned positive weights wg, such that νL(g) ≥ wg, νL(rg) ≥ wg + 1, rg = σ(g)g−1 , and the closed normal subgroup generated by the rg imposes σ = id on all of L. The basis polynomial and the polynomial of the chosen weights are P(t) = X i,ℓ,j ti+ℓ+1 = 3t(1 + t + t2 + t3 )2 , G(t) = X g twg = 3t(1 + t)(1 + t2 )2 . (21) In particular, P = (1 + t)G, and these involution relations have degree cost at most tG(t).
